resets.asserted_meaning: Clears the two-bit divider count and output clock.

ports.name: out_clk
ports.role: Registered copy of the prior two-bit count MSB; forms a divide-by-four output-clock period.

declared_unknowns.description: The internal two-bit counter and output register are not declaration-time initialized in RTL; both remain unknown until a rising edge with reset asserted. The four-state output type preserves this initial state.
Clock and reset SystemC ports use bool and are modeled only for binary 0/1 levels; X/Z on clock or reset is outside the modeled verification scope.
